*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-nfsnm-cotton-development

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) Commercial Crop- Cotton Development Scheme

*Main Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration 2) Cotton Seed production 3)  Integrated Pest Management  4)  On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services  5) State level training  6) Local Initiatives - a) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration b) Biochar

*Sub Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration -a) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid) , b) Trials on High Density Planting Systems , c) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM)
2) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production
3)  Integrated Pest Management (IPM) -Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents
4) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS)
5) State level training
6) Local Initiatives - Early termination & stubble removal demonstration
7) Biochar

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.

*Benefits*:
1) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid)- Rs. 8000/ha
2) Trials on High Density Planting Systems Rs. - 10000/ha
3) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM) -Rs.-Rs.8000/ha.

*Introduction*:
National Mission on Oilseed and Oil Palm (NMOOP) was launched by Government of India in year 2014-15. In 2018-19 GoI has merged NMOOP with NFSM as NFSM (OS&OP).  Afterwards, from the year 2022-23, NFSM (OS & OP) subsumed as National Mission On Edible Oil (NMEO) and till 2024-25, the following three missions were under this mission. 1) Mission No. 1: Oilseeds Crops 2) Mission No. 3: Tree Oilseeds Crops 3) TRFA (Oilseeds).
         The Central Government has approved a new Mission called National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds for the years 2024-25 to 2030-31. This has been done to promote the production of oilseed crops with primary focus on mustard, groundnut and soybean and to focus on secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO) along with other oilseed crops. Secondary Vegetable Oil Sub-mission is also part of the National Mission on Edible Oil Oilseeds (NMEO-OS) mission and has been included in it, which mainly includes oil extraction from secondary sources like cottonseed, rice bran and tree-borne oilseeds (TBO). Under this mission, 27 districts of Maharashtra have been selected for soybean, groundnut, safflower, mustard, Niger, sunflower and sesame. The mission will be implemented through Value Chain Cluster (VCC) and for this, a farmer producer company/cooperative/public or private organization will be selected as the Value Chain Partner (VCP) for each cluster. At the district level, the Value Chain Partners (VCPs) will be selected by the District Executive Committee (DEC).

5. Linkage to marketing system: Linking oilseed farmers and Value Chain Partners (VCPs) to marketing system and processing industries.
6. Support for oil production and collection from secondary oilseeds: Increasing production of secondary oilseeds and tree-borne oilseeds (TBOs) in particular.

question: सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे?
answer:
सेंद्रिय शेतीसाठी शासकीय योजना खालीलप्रमाणे उपलब्ध आहे:

**नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – सेंद्रिय उत्पादन एकक (Vermicompost आणि NADEP Compost Production Unit)**

ही योजना लहान व मध्यम शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे, ज्यामुळे त्यांना सेंद्रिय खत तयार करण्यासाठी अनुदान मिळते. या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतीतील कचरा, जनावरांचे वाळू, वनस्पतीचे कचरे वापरून वर्मीकंपोस्ट किंवा NADEP कंपोस्ट तयार करण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्यांना अनुदान मिळते. या कंपोस्टमुळे जमिनीची उर्वर्कता वाढते, उत्पादनात वाढ होते आणि शेतीची खर्चात बचत होते.

**मुख्य लाभ:**
- सेंद्रिय खत तयार करण्यासाठी अनुदान
- जमिनीची उर्वर्कता वाढवणे व शाश्वत उत्पादनासाठी योग्य पर्यावरण
- शेतीच्या खर्चात बचत व उत्पन्नात वाढ
- शेतीतील नैसर्गिक उत्पादनांचा वापर

**पात्रता:**
- या योजनेअंतर्गत एकूण ५ हेक्टर पर्यंत जमीन असलेले शेतकरी अर्ज करू शकतात.
- ज्यांना इतर कोणत्याही योजनेसाठी या घटकासाठी लाभ मिळाला आहे, त्यांना या योजनेसाठी पुन्हा लाभ मिळणार नाही.
- शेतकऱ्याच्या घरात किमान दोन मोठी पशुपालने (गाय, बैल, भैरव) असणे आवश्यक आहे.
- योजना पोक्रा (PoCRA) गावांसाठी लागू आहे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- अपंग असल्यास अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र
- अनुसूचित जाती/जमातीसाठी संबंधित प्रमाणपत्र
- संयुक्त खातेदार असल्यास सर्व खातेदारांची संमतीपत्र

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
1. शेतकरी महाविस्तार-एआय अ‍ॅप डाउनलोड करून आपला नोंदणीकृत शेतकरी आयडी वापरून लॉगिन करावा.
2. "DBT" टॅबवर जाऊन "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅबवर क्लिक करून "Apply for New Scheme" वर क्लिक करून अर्ज पूर्ण करावा.
3. किंवा https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या पोर्टलवर शेतकरी आयडी वापरून लॉगिन करून अर्ज करावा.
4. आधार नंबर आणि बँक खाते लिंक केले असल्यास अनुदान थेट खात्यात जमा होते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे का? किंवा आपल्या गावातील पोक्रा (PoCRA) योजना आहे का, हे तपासण्यासाठी स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधा.

*Id*:
44

*Scheme Code*:
ndksp-organic-production-unit

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Organic Production Unit

*Sub Component*:
1. Vermicompost Production Unit 
2. NADEP Compost Production Unit

*Introduction*:
Under the organic farming system, conserving nature, reducing crop production costs, and increasing the use of alternative organic and biological inputs for hazardous chemicals like chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, and hormones is the need of the hour. Vermicompost is made from farm waste, plant-based materials, and cow dung by earthworms. Vermicompost contains various bacteria, enzymes, vitamins, and other useful chemicals, which have a positive effect on plant growth. 
Similarly, processing farm waste through composting results in the decomposition of its organic matter through biological methods by microorganisms and earthworms, producing excellent humus-like organic compost. If this compost is used extensively in the fields, it will significantly improve soil health and greatly boost agricultural production. It is the need of the hour to prepare organic manure from all plant-based materials generated in the field and return it to the field. Organic manure improves soil texture and water retention capacity, ensuring an adequate supply of nutrients. The soil remains friable, which keeps it aerated. It helps in the growth of beneficial microorganisms in the farm. 
In this regard, considering the above matter, it is proposed to implement the Vermicompost Production Unit and NADEP Compost Production Unit as individual benefit components.

*Benefits*:
1.To enable small and marginal farmers in the village clusters included in the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp to adapt to the situation arising from climate change.
2. To produce nutritious food grains.
3. To practice agriculture by making proper use of natural elements without harming them.
4. To increase soil fertility and maintain it for a long time.
5. To reuse local resources in agriculture.
6. To reduce the cost of agricultural production and increase the net income of the farmer.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have received benefits from any other scheme for this component will not receive benefits again under this scheme.
2. After the unit is established, the benefit will be given to farmers who have at least two large livestock (cows, buffaloes, or bullocks) available to ensure its proper functioning.
3. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, evidence related to that.
3. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
आपल्या लहान शेतीसाठी उपयुक्त अशा शासकीय योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळण्याच्या दृष्टीने पुढील योजना तुमच्यासाठी उपयुक्त आहेत:

**१. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**
- या योजनेतील प्रत्येक शेतकरी कुटुंबाला दरवर्षी ₹६,००० अनुदान मिळते, ती ३ समान हप्त्यात दिली जाते. या योजनेत आपल्या नावावर जमीन असणे आवश्यक आहे आणि आधार लिंक असणे बंधनकारक आहे.
- **लाभ:** ₹६,००० प्रति वर्ष
- **पात्रता:** आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकरी कुटुंब
- **कागदपत्रे:** ७/१२ उतारा, आधार लिंक, इ-केवायसी
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** पोर्टलवर (pmkisan.gov.in) ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो

**२. नामो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**
- या योजनेचा लाभ PM-KISAN लाभार्थ्यांना विशेष अनुदान म्हणून मिळतो. यामध्ये दरवर्षी ₹६,००० अनुदान मिळते.
- **लाभ:** ₹६,००० प्रति वर्ष
- **पात्रता:** PM-KISAN लाभार्थी असणे आवश्यक
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** अर्ज करण्याची गरज नाही, PM-KISAN लाभार्थी असल्यास स्वतःच लाभार्थी होतो

**३. प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
- या योजनेमध्ये नैसर्गिक आपत्ती, रोग, किडीमुळे फसल नष्ट झाल्यास विमा लाभ मिळतो.
- **लाभ:** फसल विमा आणि आर्थिक सहाय्य
- **पात्रता:** नोंदणीकृत शेती क्षेत्रातील शेतकरी
- **कागदपत्रे:** आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व फसल तपशील, डिजिटल पिक नोंद
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** www.pmfby.gov.in वर अर्ज करावा लागतो

**४. डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**
- या योजनेतील लाभ अधिक मिळवण्यासाठी आपल्याकडे अल्प क्षेत्र (०.२० ते ६ हेक्टर) आणि अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी असणे आवश्यक आहे. त्यामुळे आपण जर या श्रेणीत असाल तर या योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो.
- **लाभ:** जास्त टप्प्यावर अनुदान, नवीन वाळवंट, पुराव्याची जागा, इ. वस्तूंसाठी
- **पात्रता:** अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकरी, आवश्यक दस्तऐवजे आवश्यक
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा

**५. कृषी पायाभूत सुविधा निधी (AIF)**
- या योजनेमध्ये शेतीसाठी बँक ऋणास ३% व्याज सवलत आणि २ कोटी रुपयांपर्यंत ऋण दिले जाते.
- **लाभ:** ३% व्याज सवलत आणि ऋण सुरक्षा
- **पात्रता:** प्राथमिक व द्वितीयक पिकाच्या साठवण व सुविधांसाठी ऋण अर्ज
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** बँकेच्या मंजुरीसाठी अर्ज करावा

आपण आपल्या शेतीच्या क्षेत्रानुसार आणि आपल्या जातीच्या आधारावर योग्य योजनांचा लाभ घेऊ शकता. आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे किंवा अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Main Component*:
Pradhanmantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana (PMKISAN)

*Sub Component*:
Benefit of Rs. 6000/- Per annum per family in 3 equal instalments of Rs. 2000/- each

*Introduction*:
Under the scheme land holder farmer families having cultivable land  holding are covered , They are given a benefit of Rs. 6000/- Per annum  in 3 equal instalments, with subject to exclusion criteria. Farmer family consist of husband- wife and their children's below 18 years of age .

*Benefits*:
Benefit of Rs. 6000/- Per annum per family in 3 equal instalments.

*Eligibility*:
Economically weak land holder farmer families having cultivable holding.

*Required Documents*:
A person registered as farmer as evidenced by 7/12 extract, land seeded, Aadhar seeded  and  e- KYC.

*Application Process*:
On the pmkisan portal online pmkisan.gov.in.

mahadbt-baksy

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

question: केळी बागेसाठी कोणत्या सरकारी योजनेचा लाभ मिळू शकतो?
answer:
केळी बागेसाठी शासकीय योजनेचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी खालील शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

**१. नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – फलबाग लागवड (NDKSP Horticulture Plantation)**  
ही योजना फक्त पोकरा (PoCRA) गावांसाठी आहे. या योजनेत फळबाग लागवडीसाठी (मोठ्या भागात केळी, संपूर्ण भागातील फळबाग लागवड) अनुदान मिळते. लाभार्थी शेतकऱ्यांनी आधीच इतर योजनेतून अनुदान घेतले नसावे, आणि ५ हेक्टरपर्यंतची जमीन असावी. लाभार्थ्यांना नोंदणीसाठी महाविस्तार-एआय अॅप किंवा महापोकरा पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**२. बृहस्पती फुंडकर फलबाग लागवड योजना (Bhausaheb Fundkar Horticulture Plantation Scheme)**  
ही योजना महाराष्ट्र शासनाची आहे. या योजनेत १६ फळबागीच्या रोपांसाठी १००% अनुदान मिळते. लाभार्थ्यांची निवड महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर लॉटरीद्वारे केली जाते. अर्ज ऑनलाइन करावा लागतो.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**३. बीरसा मुंडा कृषी क्रांती योजना (Birsa Munda Krushi Kranti Yojna)**  
ही योजना मुख्यतः अनुसूचित जमातीच्या शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे. या योजनेत नवीन वावरी, जुनी वावरी दुरुस्ती, फर्म पोंडचे प्लास्टिक लाइनिंग, सौर पंप, इ.साठी अनुदान मिळते. यातील फर्म पोंड आणि वावरीच्या योजनेमुळे केळी बागेसाठी पाण्याची सोय करता येते.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**४. मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना – वैयक्तिक फर्म पोंड (Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Individual Farm Pond)**  
या योजनेत फर्म पोंड तयार करण्यासाठी अनुदान मिळते. कोकण विभागात ०.२० हेक्टर तर इतर भागात ०.४० हेक्टर जमीन असणे आवश्यक आहे.  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
- सर्व योजनांसाठी ऑनलाइन अर्ज करावा लागतो.  
- आधार लिंक बँक खाते, ७/१२ उतारा, जात प्रमाणपत्र (आवश्यक असल्यास), बँक पासबुक अशी कागदपत्रे लागतात.  
- अर्जासाठी अधिक माहिती आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर (https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) किंवा नजीकच्या कृषी कार्यालयात विचारा.

आपल्या गावात पोकरा (PoCRA) योजना लागू आहे का, हे नजीकच्या कृषी अधिकाऱ्यांकडून तपासा. अर्ज करताना आपल्या शेतीच्या जमिनीचा उतारा, आधार कार्ड, आणि बँक खात्याची माहिती असणे आवश्यक आहे.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनांपैकी कोणत्या योजनेची माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रियेसाठी मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?

20. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings T x D (with polybag)
21. Horticulture Plantation-Coconut Seedlings T x D (without polybag)

*Introduction*:
The increased level of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is an important factor associated with climate change. The plantation of fruit orchards (perennial trees) is very effective in the process of sequestering this carbon dioxide (Carbon Sequestration). Along with the economic upliftment of farmers, sequestering the carbon dioxide that causes climate change is an objective of this project.

*Benefits*:
1. To expand climate-resilient farming practices through the plantation of long-term income-generating fruit crops. 
2. To achieve the objective of increasing farmers' income by generating regular and maximum income from horticulture plantation. 
3. To establish orchards of long-term, income-generating fruit crops that survive on less water, providing a supplementary business to rainfed agriculture. 
4. To reduce soil erosion and promote the conservation of green cover. 
5. To increase Carbon Sequestration.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the land falls under the Tenancy Act and the tenant's name is on the 7/12 extract, a consent letter from the tenant will be required to implement the scheme.
3. The selected beneficiary for this component should not have availed government subsidy earlier for plantation activities (such as fruit orchards, tree plantation, bamboo, etc.) on the said area.
4. The beneficiary should have the necessary irrigation facilities required for the cultivation of the proposed fruit crop.
5. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries holding up to 5.00 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
2. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes category, certificate related to that.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal:

State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders.

question: पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?
answer:
**पिक विमा योजनांचा अर्ज कसा करावा आणि कोणत्या पिकांसाठी आहे?**

महाराष्ट्रात दोन प्रमुख पिक विमा योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:  
1. **प्रधानमंत्री पिक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
2. **पुनर्घटित हवामान आधारित पिक विमा योजना (RWBCIS)**

दोन्ही योजना तुमच्या शेतीच्या विविध पिकांसाठी लागू आहेत, जसे की धान्य, तांदूळ, भात, गहू, तुर, हरभरा, ऊस, फळबाग, तसेच इतर नोंदणीकृत पिके. या योजनेंतर्गत पिकांना वादळ, जास्त पाऊस, तुषार, किडी-रोग, किंवा हवामानातील अनिश्चितता यामुळे झालेला नुकसान भरपाई दिली जाते.

**प्रधानमंत्री पिक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
- या योजनेत नोंदणीकृत पिके व नोंदणीकृत क्षेत्रातील सर्व शेतकरी अर्ज करू शकतात.
- अर्ज करण्यासाठी आपला अर्ज ऑनलाइन पोर्टलवर (www.pmfby.gov.in) कालावधीत भरावा लागतो.
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: अधिकृत कागदपत्रे (आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व पिकांची माहिती, डिजिटल पिक पाहणी).
- या योजनेत नुकसान झाल्यास निर्धारित प्रमाणात भरपाई मिळते.

**पुनर्घटित हवामान आधारित पिक विमा योजना (RWBCIS)**  
- ही योजना फळबाग व इतर नोंदणीकृत पिकांसाठी आहे.
- या योजनेतही ऑनलाइन अर्ज (www.pmfby.gov.in) करावा लागतो.
- आवश्यक कागदपत्रे: आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व पिकांची माहिती, डिजिटल पिक पाहणी.
- हवामानातील अनिश्चिततेमुळे झालेल्या नुकसानासाठी भरपाई मिळते.

**अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया:**  
1. आपला अर्ज www.pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन करा.
2. आवश्यक कागदपत्रे आणि जमीन व पिकांची माहिती भरा.
3. आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते व डिजिटल पिक पाहणी यांची माहिती जोडा.
4. अर्ज करताना निवडलेल्या पिकांची माहिती द्या.

**पिक विमा योजनांची फायदे:**  
- प्राकृतिक आपत्ती, किडी-रोग, हवामानाच्या अनिश्चिततेमुळे झालेल्या नुकसानास भरपाई मिळते.
- शेतकऱ्यांची आर्थिक स्थिती व गोपनीयता सुरक्षित राहते.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपण या योजनांचा अर्ज करताना कोणत्या पिकांसाठी विमा घेण्याचा विचार करत आहात? अधिक माहिती हवी असल्यास कृपया कळवा.

mahadbt-pmfby

*Sponsor*:
Central

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

*Sub Component*:
Risk cover  against expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm is provided . Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop.

*Introduction*:
1. This  Scheme ( RWBCI) is being implemented since Mrug Bahar 2016 in 30 districts of Maharashtra.It is implemented in Mrug and Ambiya bahar .The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers having orchard of notified crops in the notified area of given productive age are eligible to participate.
2. The Scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee farmers.
3. The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.
4. The claims are decided on weather triggers fixed .  The weather data is taken from  Automatic weather station established under Mahavedh project for the claims calculation.
5. Insurance is provided for expected crop loss due to adverse climatic conditions like Heavy rain,low rainfall, long dry spell, unseasonal rains , low temperature, high temperature, humidity, wind speed, Hailstorm.
6. One farmer can enroll for all notified crops upto 4 ha. Including both Mrug and Ambiya bahar.

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to Horticulture farmers in the event of notified crop failure in notified area due to adverse climatic condition .

*Eligibility*:
1. All farmers  growing notified crops of productive age  in the notified area.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

3. Bank account details

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
आपल्या शेतात ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज करण्यासाठी "नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प" अंतर्गत उपलब्ध असलेल्या योजनेचा वापर करता येतो. या योजनेचा मुख्य उद्देश शेतकऱ्यांना आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करून पाण्याचा वापर कार्यक्षमतेने करणे व उत्पादन वाढवणे आहे.

**योजनेचे मुख्य लाभ:**
- शेतीत पाणी व खत व्यवस्थापन सुधारण्यासाठी ड्रिप पद्धतीचा वापर करण्यासाठी अनुदान मिळते.
- उत्पादन व गुणवत्ता वाढते, तसेच शेतकऱ्यांचे एकूण उत्पन्न वाढते.
- ड्रिप प्रणाली लागवडीसाठी आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करता येतो.

**अर्ज करण्यासाठी पात्रता:**
- आपल्या जमिनीवर शासकीय योजनेतून अनुदान मिळाले असेल तर या योजनेसाठी पात्र नाही.
- जर आपण अगोदरच ७ वर्षांपूर्वी इतर योजनेतून ड्रिप प्रणालीसाठी अनुदान घेतले असेल, तर त्या जमिनीसाठी पात्रता नाही. पण ५ हेक्टरपर्यंतच्या जमिनीवर अनुदान मिळू शकते.
- जमिनीवर पाणी आणि वीज उपलब्ध असावी लागते.
- अर्जदाराने आधार आणि बँक खात्याचा लिंक करणे आवश्यक आहे.

**अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया:**
1. आपल्या मोबाईलमध्ये "Mahavistaar-AI Application" गुगल प्ले स्टोअरवरून डाउनलोड करा.
2. अर्जदार आयडीने लॉगिन करा.
3. डॅशबोर्डवर "DBT" टॅब निवडा.
4. "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅब निवडा.
5. "Click Here" लिंकवर क्लिक करून नवीन योजनेसाठी अर्ज करा.
6. किंवा ऑनलाइन "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" या पोर्टलवर जाऊन आपला आयडीने लॉगिन करा आणि अर्ज करा.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- जर आपण अनुसूचित जाती/जमातीचे असाल तर जात प्रमाणपत्र द्यावे लागेल.
- संयुक्त खात्याचे अर्जदार असाल तर इतर खातेदारांची संमतीपत्र द्यावी लागेल.
- दिव्यांग असाल तर दिव्यांग प्रमाणपत्र द्यावे लागेल.

**टीप:** ही योजना केवळ "पॉक्रा" गावांसाठी उपलब्ध आहे. आपले गाव "पॉक्रा" गाव नसल्यामुळे आपण या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करू शकत नाही.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला आपल्या भागातील इतर कोणत्या योजना किंवा ड्रिप प्रणालीसाठी अर्ज करण्याची माहिती हवी आहे का?

*Scheme Code*:

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

question: माझ्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार PM-KISAN मध्ये किती रक्कम मिळेल?
answer:
**प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)**

ही योजना शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक रासात्मक आर्थिक मदत देते. आपल्या जमिनीच्या आकारानुसार रक्कम दिली जात नाही; योजनेतील लाभ आपल्या जातीच्या आर्थिक श्रेणीवर आणि जमीनच्या मालकत्वावर अवलंबून असतो.

मुख्य लाभ:
- आपल्या कुटुंबासाठी वर्षाला **₹6,000** मिळतात, ती तीन समान हप्त्यांमध्ये (प्रत्येकी ₹2,000) दिली जाते.
- या लाभासाठी आपल्या नावावर 7/12 उतारा, आधार कार्ड, आणि इलेक्ट्रॉनिक केवायसी असणे आवश्यक आहे.

पात्रता:
- आपल्या नावावर शेतीसाठी वापरता येणारी जमीन असणे आवश्यक आहे.
- आपली जाती श्रेणी आर्थिक दृष्ट्या कमकुवत असणे आवश्यक आहे.

अर्ज प्रक्रिया:
- अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या ऑनलाईन पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.
- आपल्या नावावर जमीनचा उतारा, आधार कार्ड आणि इलेक्ट्रॉनिक केवायसी असणे आवश्यक आहे.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला या योजनेचा अर्ज कसा करावा किंवा अर्जाची स्थिती तपासायची आहे का?

question: मी PM-KISAN साठी पात्र आहे का
answer:
आपण **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)** साठी पात्र आहात का हे तपासल्यास, या योजनेची मुख्य तरतुदी खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत:

- या योजनेअंतर्गत आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत असलेल्या शेतकरी कुटुंबांना प्रत्येक वर्षी एकूण **₹6,000/-** रोख अनुदान तीन समान हप्त्यांत म्हणजेच प्रत्येकी ₹2,000/- मिळते.
- या योजनेतील लाभासाठी शेतकऱ्याच्या कुटुंबात वडील, आई आणि १८ वर्षांखालील मुले समाविष्ट असतात.
- अर्ज करण्यासाठी आपल्या नावावर ७/१२ उतारा, जमीन नोंदणी, आधार कार्ड आणि ई-केवायसी असणे आवश्यक आहे.
- अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या ऑनलाइन पोर्टलवर करता येतो.

आपल्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये आपली जमीन ०.५५ हेक्टर आहे आणि आपण जनरल श्रेणीतील आहात. या योजनेतील अर्जासाठी जमीन असणे आवश्यक आहे. आपण शेतकरी नोंदणी आणि आधार लिंक असल्यास आपण या योजनेसाठी पात्र असू शकता.

**स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा कृषी सहाय्यक यांच्याशी संपर्क साधून आपला अर्ज तपासा.**

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्याला PM-KISAN योजनेसाठी अर्ज कसा करायचा हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला आणखी कोणत्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती हवी आहे का?

question: सोयाबीन पिकासाठी PMFBY विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे?
answer:
सोयाबीन पिकासाठी **प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)** अंतर्गत विमा कव्हरेज (विमा अनुदान) शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या पीकाच्या नुकसानीच्या भरपाईसाठी दिला जातो. सोयाबीन हे तेलबिया पीक आहे, त्यामुळे PMFBY अंतर्गत विमा कव्हरेज खालीलप्रमाणे आहे:

- शेतकऱ्यांना विमा कव्हरेजसाठी दरवर्षी केवळ १.५% विमा दर (प्रीमियम) द्यावा लागतो.
- उर्वरित विमा दराचा खर्च शासनाच्या अनुदानाने भाग पाडला जातो.
- विमा कव्हरेजची रक्कम नुकसानीच्या प्रमाणानुसार दिली जाते, त्यामुळे एका ठराविक रकमेची गारंटी नाही, पण नुकसानीच्या भरपाईसाठी विमा कंपन्या व शासन निर्धारित नियमांनुसार भरपाई देतात.
- विमा लागू करण्यासाठी आधार क्रमांक आवश्यक आहे.

ही योजना विमा अनुदानासाठी शेतकऱ्यांना एकसारख्या प्रमाणात फायदा देते आणि विमा दराची वाढ किंवा घट शासनाच्या निर्णयानुसार बदलू शकते.

question: कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS विमा कव्हरेज किती आहे
answer:
कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS (Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme) या पीक विमा योजनेंतर्गत विमा कव्हरेज असा आहे:

RWBCIS ही योजना वातावरणातील अनिश्चिततेमुळे झालेल्या नुकसानासाठी शेतकऱ्यांना आर्थिक संरक्षण देते. या योजनेंतर्गत कापूस पिकासाठी वातावरणातील अपेक्षित वाढ न झाल्यास, अतिवृष्टी, किंवा अन्य वातावरणीय अपघातांमुळे नुकसान झाल्यास शेतकऱ्यांना विमा नुकसान भरपाई मिळते.

विमा कव्हरेजची रक्कम व नुकसान भरपाई योजनेच्या नियमांनुसार आणि शासकीय अधिसूचनेनुसार ठरवली जाते. या योजनेची अंमलबजावणी करण्यासाठी शासनाने नियम आणि मार्गदर्शक सूचना बदलल्या आहेत. नुकसान भरपाई शेतकऱ्यांच्या जमिनीच्या क्षेत्रावर आधारित आणि शासकीय अधिसूचनेनुसार दिली जाते.

कापूस पिकासाठी RWBCIS योजनेत विमा कव्हरेज व नुकसान भरपाईची रक्कम व त्यासंबंधी अधिक माहिती व अर्ज प्रक्रिया यासाठी आपल्या गावातील कृषी कार्यालयाशी किंवा जिल्हा कृषी अधिकारी यांच्याशी संपर्क साधावा.

question: Me PDMC yojana la eligible ahe ka?
answer:
महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकरी आपल्या शेतीच्या जमिनीच्या मालकांना विविध शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ मिळवू शकतात. आपल्या प्रोफाइलमध्ये आपली जमीन 1.81 हेक्टर आहे, आणि आपण सामान्य श्रेणीतील आहात. आपण "पीडीएमसी" (Per Drop More Crop - PM-RKVY) या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहात का, याबद्दल माहिती मिळवण्यासाठी मी योजना माहिती तपासत आहे.

माझ्या तपासणीनुसार, "पीडीएमसी" (Per Drop More Crop) या योजनेसाठी विशिष्ट शासकीय माहिती उपलब्ध नाही. त्यामुळे आपण या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करण्यासाठी आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी अधिकारी किंवा कृषी कार्यालयात विचारू शकता.

तसेच, आपल्याला इतर शासकीय योजनांची माहिती हवी असल्यास मी त्यांची माहिती देऊ शकतो. आपल्याला आपल्या जमिनीच्या आधारे उपलब्ध असलेल्या योजनांची यादी पाहायची आहे का?

question: मी माझ्या शेतामध्ये कापसाची लागवड करण्याची योजना आखत आहे. यासाठी मी पात्र असलेल्या कोणत्याही शासकीय योजना आहेत का?
answer:
आपण कापसाची लागवड करण्यासाठी शासकीय योजनांची माहिती विचारत आहात. खालील महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

**१. राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा व पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) – कपाशी विकास योजना**  
ही योजना १३ जिल्ह्यांमध्ये (धुळे, नांदुरबार, जालना, अहिल्यानगर, चांद्रभागा, जालना, बीड, नांदेड, बुलढाणा, अकोला, अमरावती, यवतमाळ, वर्धा) लागू आहे.  
- अंतरपिक (मुग, उडीद) विषयक फ्रंट-लाईन दर्शने (FLD) दर हेक्टरी ₹८,०००  
- उच्च घनतेच्या लागवडीसाठी चाचणी ₹१०,०००/हेक्टर  
- संयुक्त पिक व्यवस्थापन (ICM) चे FLD ₹८,०००/हेक्टर  
- देसी/ईएलएस कपाशी बियाणे उत्पादन FLD ₹९,०००/हेक्टर  
- रोगनियंत्रण औषधे व जैविक एजंट वितरण ₹५००/हेक्टर किंवा खर्चाच्या ५०% (कमी असल्यास)  
- ऑनलाइन कीड निरीक्षण व सल्ला सेवा ₹८,०००/हेक्टर  
- राज्यस्तरीय प्रशिक्षण ₹४०,०००/प्रशिक्षण  
- जलद नाश व अवशेष निष्कर्ष FLD ₹५,०००/हेक्टर  
- बायोचार एकक ₹१०,०००/एकक  
- लाभार्थींनी अर्जासाठी महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर नोंदणी करणे आवश्यक आहे.  
- अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर (https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin) करावा लागतो.

**२. डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
- या योजनेचा लाभ अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांना मिळतो.  
- नवीन सिंचन व्यवस्था (पंपसेट, सोलर पंप, HDPE पाइप, फार्म पोंड लाईनिंग, इ.साठी अनुदान मिळते.  
- अर्जासाठी आवश्यक असलेली कागदपत्रे: जातीचा दाखला, ७/१२ उतारा, आधार लिंक बँक खाते.  
- अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाइन करावा लागतो.

**३. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी योजना (PM-KISAN)**  
- लाभार्थ्यांना दरवर्षी ₹६,००० अनुदान दिले जाते (३ समान हप्त्यांमध्ये).  
- लाभार्थ्यांना ७/१२ उतारा, आधार लिंक बँक खाते आवश्यक आहे.  
- अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**४. प्रधानमंत्री पिक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
- कपाशी विम्यासाठी अर्ज करू शकता.  
- अर्जासाठी आवश्यक असलेली कागदपत्रे: आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, जमीन व पिकाची माहिती.  
- अर्ज pmfby.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**आपल्या पात्रतेसाठी आणि अर्ज प्रक्रियेसाठी, आपल्या शेतीचा प्रमाणपत्र, जातीचा दाखला (BAKSYसाठी), आधार कार्ड व बँक खाते यांची अचूक माहिती आवश्यक आहे.**

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.

3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.

5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:

2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. 3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:

1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). 4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.

As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

*Introduction*:

2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season . Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

question: मी कोणकोणत्या योजनांसाठी पात्र आहे?
answer:
आपल्या पात्रतेसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या काही महत्त्वाच्या शासकीय शेती योजना खालीलप्रमाणे आहेत. आपले जातीय वर्ग (सामान्य), जमिनीचे क्षेत्र (0.55 हेक्टर), आणि आपल्या गावाची माहिती लक्षात घेऊन खालील योजनांसाठी आपण पात्र असू शकता:

**राज्य योजना:**

- **डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीविषयक अनुदान, तंत्रज्ञान आणि विविध सुविधा देणारी योजना. अर्जासाठी आवश्यक कागदपत्रे व अर्ज प्रक्रिया वेगळ्या विभागानुसार वेगळी असते.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (NDKSP) घटक योजना**  
  ही योजना विविध घटकांसाठी असते, जसे की पिकांची लागवड, ड्रिप सिंचन, गोडाऊन बांधणी, शेतपिकांची लागवड, बांधवता भांडवल, गायींचे पालन, सीमेवर पाणी भरणे, सागर तलाव बांधणी, आणि अन्य अनुदान योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **मुख्यमंत्री शाश्वत कृषी सिंचन योजना**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना शेतीसाठी पाणी सुविधा देण्यासाठी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी अपघात सुरक्षा योजना**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना अपघातामुळे झालेल्या नुकसानासाठी आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

**केंद्र योजना:**

- **नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी (NSMNY)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना वार्षिक आर्थिक मदत देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री कृषी संवर्धन योजना (PM-RKVY)**  
  विविध शेती विकास योजना, जसे की शेती विकास, तंत्रज्ञान प्राप्ती, विविध अनुदान व सहाय्य.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **प्रधानमंत्री फसल विमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
  विविध फसलींच्या विम्यासाठी अनुदान देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

- **महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार हमी योजना (MGNREGS)**  
  शेतकऱ्यांना रोजगाराची गारंटी देणारी योजना.  
  **स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

प्रत्येक योजनेची अर्ज प्रक्रिया, पात्रता, आवश्यक कागदपत्रे व अनुदानाची रक्कम वेगळी असते. आपण अर्ज करण्यासाठी आपल्या तालुका कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधावा.

आपल्याला यापैकी कोणत्या योजनेची अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का? किंवा अर्ज कसा करायचा हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे का?

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

question: माझ्या शेतात ठिबक सिंचन (ड्रिप इरिगेशन) आणि तुषार सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर) बसवण्यासाठी कोणती योजना उपलब्ध आहे का?
answer:
आपल्या शेतात ठिबक सिंचन (ड्रिप इरिगेशन) आणि तुषार सिंचन (स्प्रिंकलर) बसवण्यासाठी **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प** अंतर्गत दोन योजना उपलब्ध आहेत:

1. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – ड्रिप सिंचन (NDKSP Drip Irrigation)**
2. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प – स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन (NDKSP Sprinkler Irrigation)**

ही योजना फक्त **PoCRA (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) गावांसाठी लागू आहे.** या योजनेत शेतकऱ्यांना आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञानाचा वापर करून ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन बसवण्यासाठी आर्थिक मदत मिळते. यामुळे पाण्याचा वापर वाढवता येतो, उत्पादनात वाढ होते आणि शेतकऱ्यांचे उत्पन्न वाढते.

**पात्रता:**
- आपल्या शेतात या प्रकारची सिंचन योजना आधी ७ वर्षांत घेतली नसावी.
- शेतकऱ्याच्या नावावर ५ हेक्टरपर्यंत जमीन असावी.
- पाणी व वीज उपलब्ध असावी.
- आपण आपल्या गावात PoCRA योजनेत समाविष्ट आहात का, हे तपासावे.

**आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**
- आरक्षित जातीचे असल्यास जात प्रमाणपत्र
- संयुक्त खाते असल्यास संमतीपत्र
- अपंग असल्यास अपंगत्व प्रमाणपत्र

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**
- "महाविस्तार-एआय अ‍ॅप" मधून किंवा https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications या वेबसाईटवर आपल्या Farmer ID ने लॉगिन करा.
- "DBT" विभागातून "NDKSP (PoCRA)" टॅब निवडा आणि "Apply for New Scheme" वर क्लिक करा.
- आपले अर्ज पूर्ण करा व आधार नंबर बँक खात्याशी लिंक करा.

**महत्त्वाचे:** ही योजना केवळ PoCRA गावांसाठी लागू आहे. आपल्या गावात या योजनेसाठी नोंदणी आहे का, हे आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाकडे तपासा.

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

आपल्या गावात या योजनेची नोंदणी आहे का, हे तपासायचे आहे का? किंवा आपल्याला अर्ज करण्यासाठी मार्गदर्शन हवे आहे का?

*Scheme Name*:
Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp

*Main Component*:
Drip Irrigation

*Sub Component*:
1. Inline Drip Irrigation
2. Online Drip Irrigation

*Introduction*:
The Central Government has issued Operational Guidelines in the year 2024 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop, a centrally sponsored micro-irrigation scheme. This scheme is being implemented from the year 2022-23 under the name Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - Per Drop More Crop. The Commissionerate of Agriculture, has issued guidelines for the micro-irrigation scheme. On the lines of this scheme, a micro-irrigation scheme (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation) will be implemented under the Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Project. Accordingly, the following guidelines are being issued for implementing the approved micro-irrigation component in the villages selected under the project.

*Benefits*:
1.To increase the area under micro-irrigation by using modern technology in the project districts and to promote climate-resilient farming practices.
2. To encourage micro-irrigation methods for the development of agriculture and horticulture crops based on modern technology.
3. To manage fertilizers through the micro-irrigation system.
4. To increase agricultural production, the quality of agricultural produce, and consequently, the total income of farmers.
5. To increase water use efficiency.

*Eligibility*:
1. Farmers who have already received benefits on same land from any other scheme will not be eligible under this scheme.
2. If the farmer has availed the benefits of micro-irrigation components under any government scheme in the last 7 years, such areas will be excluded, and the remaining area can receive benefits within the total limit of 5 hectares.
3. The farmer must have access to water supply and electricity.
4. The benefits of this component under the project will be available to beneficiaries who own up to 5 hectares of land.

*Required Documents*:
1. If the applicant belongs to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category, a caste certificate should be provided.
2. If the applicant is a joint account holder, a consent letter from the other account holders shall be submitted.
3. If the applicant is a person with disability, a disability certificate should be provided.

*Application Process*:
The NDKSP DBT Portal has been created with the following objectives - 
DBT System for accepting and processing subsidy applications received from farmers. Through this system, farmers can directly login and apply for financial assistance under scheme and disbursement of funds happen directly to the Aadhaar linked account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. There is no need for farmer to visit a government office to apply for subsidy or receive disbursed funds. Also, farmers can track and monitor their applications in real time which shows transparency in NDKSP operations. This system facilitates NDKSP to perform its approval process in 100% paperless manner which eliminates intermediaries and establishes credibility. 
To avail the benefits of the components under the project, the beneficiary (farmer) must directly login on the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system using their Farmer ID. After login, the beneficiary becomes eligible to receive the project benefits. Additionally, it is mandatory for the beneficiary to link their Aadhaar number with their bank account so that the benefit amount can be directly transferred to their personal bank account.
The following farmer attributes need to be entered in the Portal: 
Farmer Attributes: (Essential): 
State, District, Sub-District/Block, Village, Farmer Name, Type of Identity  Farmer ID for landholder farmer is essential, Gender, Category, land cosent letter for joint landholders. 
Farmer Login and application Module:
Step 1: Farmer Login and Application Process through the "Mahavistaar-AI Application"
a) First, download and install the "Mahavistaar-AI Application" from the "Google Play Store" on your mobile.
b) After entering the application, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, click the "DBT" tab at the bottom right of the Dashboard screen.
d) Upon clicking, click the "NDKSP (PoCRA)" tab.
e) To avail benefits for various items under individual components, click the "Click Here" link at the end of this screen to apply.
f) Following this, your NDKSP (PoCRA) project dashboard screen will be available.
g) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.
Step 2: Farmer Login and application Process through the "Project's DBT Web Portal"
a) Visit to "https://mahapocra.gov.in/mr/applications" NDKSP 2.0 website
b) After entering the webpage of Farmer login, enter your registered Farmer ID.
c) After successful login, dashboard screen will be available.
d) Complete the application process by clicking the "Apply for New Scheme" tab.

https://mahapocra.gov.in/documents/Micro_Irrigation_Guideline_NDKSP_2.0.pdf

*Disclaimer Text*:
This scheme is eligible for PoCRA villages only.

question: माझ्या शेतात कापूस लागवड करायची आहे. त्यासाठी मला मदत मिळू शकेल अशा कोणत्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती द्या.
answer:
आपल्या कापूस लागवडीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती खाली दिली आहे:

**१. राष्ट्रीय अन्न सुरक्षा आणि पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) कॉटन डेव्हलपमेंट योजना**
ही योजना कापूस लागवडीसाठी विशेषतः दिली जाते. यात पिकाचे दाखले, उच्च गुणवत्तेची बी उत्पादन, रोग व कीड नियंत्रण, ऑनलाइन निगराणी व सल्ला, राज्य स्तरीय प्रशिक्षण आणि जिल्हातील विविध अभ्यासक्रम यांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनेत अनुदान असलेल्या घटकांमध्ये पिकाचे दाखले (रु. ८,०००/हेक्टर), उच्च घनता लागवड (रु. १०,०००/हेक्टर), जैविक रोगनियंत्रण (रु. ५००/हेक्टर किंवा खर्चाचा ५०%) आणि ऑनलाइन निगराणी (रु. ८,०००/हेक्टर) यांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनेत अर्ज महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर केला जातो.

**२. डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY)**
ही योजना अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी आहे. यात नवीन सिंचन व्यवस्था, जुन्या व्यवस्थेची मरम्मत, प्लास्टिक लाईनिंग, विद्युत जोडणी, पंपसेट, सौर पंप, ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन, शेती उपकरणे यांसाठी अनुदान दिले जाते. या योजनेची अर्ज प्रक्रिया महाडीबीटी पोर्टलवर ऑनलाईन होते. या योजनेत अनुसूचित जाती/नवबौद्ध शेतकऱ्यांसाठी अनुदान मिळते.

**३. प्रधानमंत्री किसान सन्मान निधी (PM-KISAN)**
ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे. या योजनेत जमिनीवरील कुटुंबांना दरवर्षी रु. ६,००० तीन समान हप्त्यांत दिले जाते. अर्ज करण्यासाठी शेतकरी नोंदणी आणि आधार लिंक असणे आवश्यक आहे. अर्ज pmkisan.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**४. प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (PMFBY)**
ही योजना कापूस आणि इतर नोंदणीकृत पिकांसाठी लागू आहे. यात विमा व अनुदान मिळते, ज्यामुळे पिकांना आपत्ती, कीड, रोग यामुळे झालेला नुकसान भरपाई मिळते. अर्ज पीएमएफबीवाय पोर्टलवर करावा लागतो.

**५. कृषी पायाभूत सुविधा निधी (AIF)**
ही केंद्र शासनाची योजना आहे. यात शेतीसाठी आवश्यक असलेल्या पायाभूत सुविधांसाठी बँक ऋणावर ३% व्याज सवलत व २ कोटी रुपयांपर्यंत गारंटी मिळते. अर्ज बँकेतून करावा लागतो.

**आपल्या शेतकरी प्रोफाइलवर आधारित पात्रता व अर्ज प्रक्रिया आपल्याला लगेच माहिती देऊ शकेन. आपण कोणत्या योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे का? किंवा अर्ज प्रक्रिया जाणून घ्यायची आहे का?**

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

*Introduction*:

The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.
